_label_precision.method: zero-shot SigLIP base (google/siglip-base-patch16-224), prompts in scripts/images/prompts.py (version 2); argmax over 12 classes, logo merged into designed_graphic. Precision read by eye on contact sheets of 30 random images per class (data/images/sheets/<class>_1.jpg, round 2, an independent sample drawn after the prompts were fixed; round 1 was used to fix the prompts and is listed separately).

designed_graphic.errors: a stadium photo with a logo, an ad poster

people_photo.errors: illustrations of people, designed speaker cards

code_screenshot.errors: app UI, designed banners with code styling

other_photo.errors: photos where people are the subject, a map, a painting

meme.errors: TV stills, tweets, cartoons that are not memes

social_screenshot.errors: other app and web screenshots (Hugging Face model pages, app UIs); nearly all errors are still screenshots of software

_label_precision.margin_does_not_help: in round 1 the zero-shot margin did not separate right from wrong product screenshots; the 'confident' subset (top half of margin within class) is used as a stricter set, not as a validated high-precision set

by_eye.illustration_render round 1 (36): 12 confidently AI-generated, 7 confidently not, 17 cannot tell

_ai_generated.verdict: Not reliable. The open detector (Ateeqq/ai-vs-human-image-detector) gives p>0.99 to nearly every screenshot, graphic and photo; the zero-shot AI score separates illustration from photo, not AI from human-made. About a third of 'illustration_render' images are recognisably AI-generated by eye and a third cannot be told. No confident AI-generated subset large enough for a within-account comparison could be built; the effect of 'AI slop' is reported only as the effect of the illustration/render class, which mixes AI images with 3D renders and human illustration.

_model.design: three baseline members (ts46_s1, ts46_s2, compare_v2_full) each fine-tuned 2,000 steps (best checkpoint by validation NLL: step 500 in all six) on the image-subset table (1,018 accounts with 5+ fetched images, 134,296 rows, 14,291 with an image), once with the image inputs (SigLIP 768-d + 15 image attributes as auxiliary inputs) and once without (control); same rows, seeds, steps. Ensembles of three per arm. 'base' = the untouched baseline ensemble.

ordinary_same_account_test_pairs_in_tabl.design: test-split audience rows of the image-subset table, same account, within 30 days, likes differ 1.25x+

_meta.corpus: work/filtered/posts.parquet; images fetched from pbs.twimg.com (first photo of a post, 680 px rendition)
_meta.rule:
`supported` only when it survives every check, decided by a fixed rule (set before the effects were run):
  three tests per set of posts, each with a 95% interval from resampling accounts:
    pairs     win rate in same-account pairs, posting order balanced                  (interval excludes 50%)
    ratio     likes ratio with / without inside accounts that have both               (interval excludes 1)
    adjusted  the same ratio with the other image types and the text attributes held fixed (interval excludes 1; where defined)
  sets: MAIN = every post of company and founder accounts; STRICT = the same with image posts restricted to confident
  type labels (zero-shot margin in the top half of the class); ALL = every post of every account with an own announcement.
  survives   every test passes in MAIN or in STRICT, at least one passes in the other, same direction in both
  main_only  every test passes in MAIN; same direction in STRICT but no test passes there
  wider_only every test passes only in ALL
  leaning    same direction everywhere, some test passes somewhere
  none       nothing passes, or the direction flips
  too_thin   under 100 pairs or under 20 accounts in MAIN
Each entry also carries the launch-post and announcement subsets, follower tiers and a time split (MAIN, before and from
2026-04-23). Grade: A survives and is confirmed in both periods; B survives; B- main_only; C wider_only. Entries without
a grade carry no advice.
_meta.baseline: median likes of the account's previous 30 posts (at least 8); posts captured under 3 days after posting dropped
_meta.posts_without_a_fetched_image: posts with a photo whose image was not fetched are left out of every comparison
